title: Südanlage, Gießen
description:
Big Room | ELEPHANT HOUSE – Stylish All-Inclusive Co-Living in Central Giessen

Moving to Giessen? Make yourself at home from day one!

Welcome to ELEPHANT HOUSE – a modern, fully furnished co-living apartment right in the heart of Giessen. Whether you're starting university, a new job, an internship or simply a new chapter, we've made moving in as easy as possible.

Big Room | Approx. 21–25 m2 | €650/month ALL-IN
Love having your own space? Our Big Rooms offer plenty of it! Bright, generously sized and fully furnished, with separate areas for sleeping, working and relaxing. Enjoy stylish furniture, a comfortable armchair, your own mini-fridge and lots of natural light. Perfect if you want the feeling of your own little apartment while enjoying the benefits of shared living.

Your Room – Spacious & Ready to Move In
Enjoy your own bright, beautifully furnished private room with everything you need:
•	Comfortable bed with bedding included
•	Desk and chair
•	Wardrobe and plenty of storage
•	Cozy armchair
•	Your own mini-fridge
•	Electric window blinds
•	Stylish furniture and decoration
Just bring your suitcase!

Our apartment offers approximately 40 m2 of beautifully furnished shared living space. Relax on the sofas, enjoy dinner with your housemates or cook together in our fully equipped kitchen. Pots, pans, plates, cutlery, coffee machine, microwave – it's all here! You'll also have access to two modern shared shower bathrooms and an additional separate toilet. A professional cleaner takes care of the bathrooms and shared areas twice a month, while everyone helps keep the apartment tidy.

All-Inclusive – One Price, No Surprises
Electricity, heating, water, Wi-Fi, furniture, washing machine and dryer are all included. No furniture buyout, no separate utility contracts and no additional utility bills at the end of the year.

Stay Flexible
Moving to Giessen and not sure how long you'll stay? Start with a minimum stay of just 3 months! After that, you're welcome to stay longer, with the flexibility to move out on just 8 weeks' notice.
No one-year commitment, no furniture to buy and no moving hassle. Perfect if you're new to Giessen and want to settle in before making long-term plans.

Location – Right in the City
ELEPHANT HOUSE is located at Südanlage 20, close to Giessen's main shopping street, Seltersweg. Cafés, restaurants, bars and shops are just around the corner. Both JLU and THM are easily accessible, with convenient public transport connections.

Shared Living – The Best Part
We believe a great shared apartment is about more than beautiful rooms.
That's why we personally review applications to bring together housemates who enjoy a friendly, respectful and relaxed living environment. Students, young professionals, trainees and newcomers are all welcome. Enjoy spending time together – while always having your own private space.

Easy Digital Move-In
Apply online, tell us a little about yourself and get to know us through messages or a video call. Rental agreements are handled digitally, and self-check-in makes moving in simple.

ELEPHANT HOUSE – Arrive. Connect. Feel at home.
